draft_en.subject: ODM source for the ADJ networking range - 8-PoE L2+ and budget unmanaged units
draft_en.body:
Buongiorno,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the switches in the ADJ networking range we can be an ODM source in your retail packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); a budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged unit, STC-028GP, $27.2. Logo on the unit is free; colour box from 200 sets.

One question: which network SKU sells most through your Italian retail channel - a PoE switch or a plain desktop switch?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
